## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this feature solve? Who would benefit from it?

Example: "As a photographer, I often need to batch-rename files after export, but ImageForge doesn't support custom naming templates."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative approaches or workarounds?

## Target Platforms

- [ ] Web
- [ ] iOS
- [ ] Android
- [ ] All platforms

## Priority / Impact

Who would use this feature?

- [ ] All users (high priority)
- [ ] Power users / batch workflows
- [ ] Specific use case (describe below)

## Additional Context

Any mockups, reference implementations in other tools, or related issues.
